description: Resource attributes for outgoing webhook consumers, endpoints, messages, delivery attempts, and provider portal sessions.

tenantId.description: Owning tenant identifier for tenant-bound owners or source-tenant delivery operations.

instanceId.description: Immutable owning instance identifier for instance-owned webhook configuration.

ownerKindId.description: Supported owner kind: Tenant, Organization, Group, User, or Instance.

ownerId.description: Identifier of the typed webhook owner.

organizationId.description: Owning organization identifier. Used by islamuevent_org_admin derived role for organization-owned webhook resources.

groupId.description: Owning group identifier for group-owned webhook resources.

userId.description: Owning user identifier for user-owned webhook resources.

provider.description: Optional provider name, such as local or svix.
